subject: Renewal launchpad: runway, uplift items & QBR date poll
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion kickoff

Hey Logan —

Thanks for the heads-up last week. We discussed internally and are ready to start the renewal conversation for our annual commitment that renews end of November. High level: we expect to increase monthly throughput (tokens) by ~45% for the coming year and want to align on term, uplift pricing, and any compliance deliverables (SOC2 evidence) the procurement team will need.

Quick asks to kick off:
- Proposed QBR window(s) — we prefer early Oct but can be flexible the week of Oct 12
- A one-page summary of proposed new terms and pricing (ballpark) so we can surface to procurement
- List of security/attestation docs you can provide (SOC2 type II, data retention, audit log access)

I attached our Q3 usage export so you have the traffic profile. Looping Dev (procurement) if we need more details.

Thanks —
Samantha Reed
Head of Platform Ops, NovaHealth
Attachments: NovaHealth_usage_report_Q3.csv
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal launchpad: runway, uplift items & QBR date poll

Samantha — great, thanks for the usage file and clear asks. I27ll propose a short kickoff + QBR to align stakeholders and lock the renewal runway. See proposed next steps below.

Summary (what we27ll cover in kickoff):
- Current usage and expected 45% uplift: sizing & capacity implications
- Term options: 12 vs 24 month (unit price profile, committed throughput tiers)
- Security & compliance deliverables we can provide and timeline (Ben to confirm)
- Operational handoffs: onboarding for additional capacity, KPIs to track post-renewal

Proposed immediate actions (owners):
- Ben Carter: prepare a one-page proposal with pricing tiers and a recommended commit path (ETA: 3 business days)
- Marissa Cole: coordinate stakeholder list for QBR and invite cadence (ETA: calendar poll by end of day)
- Monica Patel: prepare SOW template and DocuSign-ready terms for the selected option (ETA: 2 business days)
- Logan: own kickoff agenda and align internal SMEs for technical questions

QBR windows: please pick any of the slots on this poll: https://doodle.com/poll/renewal-novahealth (we can also do Tue/Wed mornings PT the week of Oct 12 if easier)

Procurement asks we can action now: SOC2 evidence & high-level retention policy. Ben — can you confirm which artifacts we can deliver by next Wed?

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
P: (415) 555-0187
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal launchpad: runway, uplift items & QBR date poll

Agree with Logan27s plan. Quick notes on artifacts and constraints:

Artifacts we can provide right away:
- SOC2 Type II summary + auditor contact (PDF)
- High-level retention & access policy (internal doc)
- Token-level latency/cost breakdown for Q3 (can map to your attached CSV)

Outstanding items that need coordination:
- If NovaHealth requires an on-prem or VPC Private deployment for regulated workloads, that27s a different SOW. Monica, flag if we should prepare options.
- Pricing: for a 45% uplift we can propose a stepped commit with a 10% effective unit discount on a 12m commit, bigger savings on 24m. I27ll include both options in the one-pager.

I attached the SOC2 questions packet we typically share with procurement. Samantha/Devon: please confirm if you need a full SOC2 report or the summary is sufficient for initial review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_questions_v1.pdf
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal launchpad: runway, uplift items & QBR date poll

Thanks everyone — good cadence. Quick confirmations: 
- We prefer Oct 13 at 10:00 AM PT for the QBR kickoff (Marissa, if you can lock that slot).
- For procurement, the SOC2 summary and auditor contact is fine to start; procurement will request the full report if needed later. Please send the summary and the auditor email.
- We have one technical blocker: our security team wants to confirm whether Redwood can offer field-level logging for specific PII flows (even if redacted). Is that something the platform can surface in logs or via the audit API? If not, they27ll request an architectural review during the QBR.

Next steps for you all:
- Ben: attach SOC2 summary + auditor email into HubSpot record and cc Devon
- Marissa: calendar invite for Oct 13 10:00 AM PT (include internal and technical SMEs)
- Monica: drop the SOW outline in the shared drive (we can use the DocuSign link Logan sent once the option is selected)

Devon, I27ll introduce our security lead if we need a separate thread for architecture questions.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Platform Ops, NovaHealth
